editorial.blurb: Cafe Tola #2 is a joyful spot that takes its handmade empanadas seriously while keeping the vibe fun and unpretentious, wrapped in retro pop culture charm.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask staff to guide you through the empanada varieties when you arrive—they're made fresh throughout the day and the options rotate, so getting a personal introduction helps you find your favorite.

topDishes.note: Highly recommended, stuffed generously and worth every penny
Described as happiness in a cup, creamy and warming
